title: Brief Alcohol Withdrawal échelle (BAWS)
formula:
The BAWS Score is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tremor | No tremor | 0 |
| Not visible, but can be felt | 1 | |
| Moderate, with arms extended | 2 | |
| At rest, without arms extended | 3 | |
| Diaphoresis/sweats | No sweats | 0 |
| Mild, barely visible | 1 | |
| Beads of sweat | 2 | |
| Drenching sweats | 3 | |
| Agitation | Alert and calm ( [RASS](nabda:calc.richmond-agitation-sedation-scale-rass\) = 0) | 0 |
| Restless, anxious, apprehensive, movements not aggressive (RASS = 1) | 1 | |
| Agitated, frequent non-purposeful movement (RASS = 2) | 2 | |
| Very agitated or combative, violent (RASS = 3 or 4) | 3 | |
| Confusion e.g. time: by more than 2 days, wrong month, or wrong year place: name of building, city, state | Oriented to person, place, time | 0 |
| Disoriented to time or place, but not both | 1 | |
| Disoriented to time and place | 2 | |
| Disoriented to person | 3 | |
| Hallucinations (visual, auditory, tactile) | None | 0 |
| Mild (vague report, reality testing intact) | 1 | |
| Moderate (more defined hallucinations) | 2 | |
| Severe (obviously responding to internal stimuli, poor reality testing) | 3 | |

how_to_use.when: Utilisez-vous le Brief Alcohol Withdrawal Scale (BAWS) et souhaitez-vous apporter votre expertise ?[Rejoignez](https://www.mdcalc.com/join-us)notre équipe de contributeurs !

next_steps.advice:
**BAWS <3:**

Give diazepam 5 mg orally as needed for mild withdrawal or anxiety.

- Every 4 hrs up to 6 doses (day 1).
- Every 6 hrs up to 4 doses (day 2).
- Every 8 hrs up to 3 doses (day 3).

Reassess BAWS every 4 hrs for 24 hrs, then every 6 hrs.

**BAWS 3-5:**

Give diazepam 10 mg orally every 4 hrs until BAWS <3 (up to 10 doses).

Reassess BAWS every 4 hrs.

**BAWS 6-8:**

Give diazepam 20 mg orally every 2 hrs until BAWS <6 (up to 3 doses).

If the patient has not received any benzodiazepines, give an initial dose of 10 mg.

Reassess BAWS every 2 hrs; notify physician if BAWS >5 after 6hrs.

**BAWS >8:**

Give diazepam 20 mg orally and notify physician.
